rows.name: Forsaken Medallion
rows.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Your first attack each combat also deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage.
rows.flavor: Its face is worn smooth, but it still remembers being gold.

rows.name: Starstone Shard
rows.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Mana +{manaFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.
rows.flavor: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.

rows.name: Cutpurse's Coin
rows.textTemplate: Begin each combat Prepared. Your first attack each combat applies {venom} Venom.
rows.flavor: One face buys silence. The other buys speed.

rows.name: Gold Figurine
rows.textTemplate: Whenever you heal, gain {block} Block (even at full HP).
rows.flavor: It is very small and very heavy and it loves you.

rows.name: Golden Sprout
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, heal {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: A sapling waits inside, patient as grief.

rows.name: Whetstone Fragment
rows.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.

rows.name: Kindling Charm
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, draw {draw} extra card.

rows.name: Cinder Pouch
rows.textTemplate: Gain 25% more Cinders from combats.

rows.name: Feral Eye
rows.textTemplate: Elites offer an extra card reward choice.

rows.name: Goldleaf Charm
rows.textTemplate: At the start of your first turn, gain {block} Block.
rows.flavor: A single leaf, pressed flat, still gold. It keeps the wind off you.

rows.name: Cracked Lantern
rows.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
rows.flavor: The glass is broken but the flame refuses to notice.

rows.name: Sacrificial Knife
rows.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
rows.flavor: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.

rows.name: Cured Hide
rows.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {block} Block. Poise threshold +2 (no current consumer).
rows.flavor: The beast learned its lesson too late to keep it.

rows.name: Ivory Comb
rows.textTemplate: Every 8th card you play each combat: draw {draw} card.
rows.flavor: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.

rows.name: Cracked Tear
rows.textTemplate: Flasks are 50% stronger (rounded up).

rows.name: Sealstone Key
rows.textTemplate: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.

rows.name: Fell Warden Brand
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, draw {draw} cards.

rows.name: Bloodied Talisman
rows.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts, the victim loses {loseHp} additional HP.

rows.name: Ember Fragment
rows.textTemplate: Resting heals 15% more.

rows.name: Twinned Armor
rows.textTemplate: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.

rows.name: Blight-Touched Idol
rows.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight.
rows.flavor: The carving was of a saint. The blight made it a saint of something else.

rows.name: Warhorn
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: One long note, and the old anger answers.

rows.name: Vow of Vengeance
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: Every name you take is a name you carry.

rows.name: Pearl of Sagacity
rows.textTemplate: Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
rows.flavor: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.

rows.name: Blessed Dew
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, heal {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: It gathers on the vial overnight, from nowhere, for no one.

rows.name: Azure Sigil
rows.textTemplate: The first Skill you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
rows.flavor: Painted in a hand that trembled, by someone who steadied at the last stroke.

rows.name: Bloodstained Chalice
rows.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain {block} Block.
rows.flavor: It fills a little more each time. You have stopped asking with what.

rows.name: Goldbough Sapling
rows.textTemplate: At the start of your turn, if you have no Block: gain {block} Block.

rows.name: Wyrm Heart
rows.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.
rows.flavor: It still beats. It expects something of you.

rows.name: Ancestral Horn
rows.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less.

rows.name: Titan's Cinder
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.

rows.name: Radiant Aegis
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
rows.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.

rows.name: Flayer's Censer
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
rows.flavor: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.

rows.name: Vigilant Halo
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, heal {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.

rows.name: Carrion Talon
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
rows.flavor: The flock does not mourn. The flock moves to the next warm thing.

rows.name: Ember Idol
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
rows.flavor: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.

rows.name: Crown of Stitches
rows.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength — and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.
rows.flavor: It fits. That is the worst part.

rows.name: Warden Horn
rows.textTemplate: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
rows.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.

rows.name: Ash of Remembrance
rows.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
rows.flavor: The dead lend strength. They are not gentle about it.

rows.name: Cinder of the Fallen
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
rows.flavor: It pays out in the coin of endings. It expects you to make more of them.

rows.name: Crimson Covenant
rows.textTemplate: Your attacks apply {bleed} Bleed. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
rows.flavor: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.

rows.name: Traveler's Whetstone
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.

rows.name: Moonlit Vial
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.
rows.flavor: It never empties. It never fills, either.

rows.name: Warden's Lantern
rows.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
rows.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.

rows.name: Salted Relic
rows.textTemplate: Gain 20% more Cinders from combats.
rows.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.

rows.name: Hollowed Horn
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
rows.flavor: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.

rows.name: Gilded Tear
rows.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.

rows.name: Watchman's Badge
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.

rows.name: Howling Standard
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.

rows.name: Emberwick Charm
rows.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
rows.flavor: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.

rows.name: Carrion Morsel
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, heal {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.

rows.name: Gravetender's Bell
rows.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.
rows.flavor: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.

rows.name: Sentinel's Oath
rows.textTemplate: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
rows.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.

rows.name: Forsaken Warflag
rows.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
rows.flavor: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.

rows.name: Wrath Coil
rows.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
rows.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.

rows.name: Ashen Grip
rows.textTemplate: The first stance you enter each turn refunds {restoreStamina} Stamina.
rows.flavor: The leather remembers every hand that held it, and gives a little back.

rows.name: Lodestar Shard
rows.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {restoreMana} extra Mana.
rows.flavor: It points nowhere on any map. It points at the next cast.

rows.name: Waxen Seal
rows.textTemplate: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.
rows.flavor: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.

rows.name: Whetstone Pouch
rows.textTemplate: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
rows.flavor: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.

rows.name: Wayfarer's Knot
rows.textTemplate: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.
rows.flavor: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.

rows.name: Prismatic Thorn
rows.textTemplate: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).
rows.flavor: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.

rows.name: Restless Clasp
rows.textTemplate: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.
rows.flavor: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.

rows.name: Pauper's Diadem
rows.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.
rows.flavor: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.

rows.name: Emberjaw Token
rows.textTemplate: Your first Blade hit each combat applies {bleed} additional Bleed buildup.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Cracked War Anvil
rows.textTemplate: Your first Heavy attack each turn deals {poiseDamage} additional Break damage.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Cinderbound Crown
rows.textTemplate: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Bleed buildup each combat heals {heal} HP.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Moonwell Lens
rows.textTemplate: Your first Starstone spell each turn played after spending at least 2 Mana grants {block} Block.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Nightglass Rosary
rows.textTemplate: The second play of the same Starstone card ID in a turn restores {restoreMana} Mana, once per turn.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Fragment of the Third Sky
rows.textTemplate: Your third distinct Starstone card ID played in a turn grants {block} Block, once per turn.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Whisperglass Die
rows.textTemplate: If your first card in combat is a Blade attack, it deals +{chargeDamage} damage.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Purse of Borrowed Shadows
rows.textTemplate: After your first explicit discard each turn, gain {block} Block.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Ember Alms Bowl
rows.textTemplate: Your first nonlethal HP offering each turn grants {block} Block after its payment.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

rows.name: Ossuary Prayer Wheel
rows.textTemplate: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Crimson or Necrotic Blight buildup each combat restores {restoreMana} Mana.
rows.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.
